top_signals.title: RIP to the $1.45 Trillion FY2027 Defense Budget
top_signals.summary:
The 2026 Congressional midterms appear to have dealt a final death blow to the Trump administration’s prospective $1.45 trillion Fiscal Year 2027 Department of Defense budget request. While there remains a path forward to salvage the base budget request of $1.1 trillion, it is exceedingly difficult to envision a legislative pathway for the $350 billion reconciliation request. The reconciliation request has always faced considerable obstacles stemming from divisions within the Congressional Republican caucus, but the extent of the midterm defeat and limited legislative calendar make its prospects likely insurmountable. alerts.title: EIA forecasts Alaskan crude oil production to grow 13% in 2027
alerts.summary: After decades of decline, crude oil production in Alaska is growing, driven by two projects on Alaska's North Slope. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we expect a 23,000 barrels per day (b/d) (6%) increase in 2026, followed by a 60,000 b/d (13%) rise in 2027. At a forecast 505,000 b/d in 2027, output would be the most since 2014.
